_comment: Reader re-proof after a main LAN key change (ADR-0198 §6.2). The phone POSTs request to https://<main>/api/sync/primary-proof (TLS, certificate NOT yet trusted: it records the SPKI pin it saw), then verifies response.proof as HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the ASCII of sha256hex(bearer), over the lines label (the text ut-primary-proof-v1), primary_till_id, reader_id, nonce, host_port, pin, each followed by LF. Match = adopt pin_seen as the new pin.
